definitions.explanation: Attached to the stem of a verb to indicate continued action.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{勉強|べんきょう}し→勉強する：00527_benkyousuru⟧{続|つづ}けている。
⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{三日|みっか}→三日：02969_mikka⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{降|ふ}り→降る：00839_furu⟧{続|つづ}けている。
examples.english: It has been raining for three days straight.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何|なに}も→何も：03874_nanimo⟧⟦{言|い}わずに→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦{歩|ある}き→歩く：00538_aruku⟧{続|つづ}けた。
examples.english: He kept walking without saying anything.

examples.japanese: ⟦{諦|あきら}めずに→諦める：01813_akirameru⟧⟦{努力|どりょく}し→努力：03490_doryoku⟧{続|つづ}ければ、⟦いつか→いつか：01809_itsuka⟧⟦{夢|ゆめ}→夢：01519_yume⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かなう→叶う：05303_kanau⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: I think that if you keep trying without giving up, your dream will come true someday.

notes:
～{続|つづ}ける is an auxiliary verb meaning "to continue doing."

COMMON PATTERNS:
Verb stem + {続|つづ}ける

EXAMPLES:
- ⟦{読|よ}み→読む：00426_yomu⟧{続|つづ}ける: to continue reading
- ⟦{待|ま}ち→待つ：00469_matsu⟧{続|つづ}ける: to keep waiting
- ⟦{走|はし}り→走る：00519_hashiru⟧{続|つづ}ける: to keep running
- ⟦{働|はたら}き→働く：00503_hataraku⟧{続|つづ}ける: to keep working
- ⟦{歩|ある}き→歩く：00538_aruku⟧{続|つづ}ける: to keep walking

USAGE:
～{続|つづ}ける emphasizes sustained, persistent action over time. Often implies effort or determination.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ～{続|つづ}ける: continued action (emphasizes persistence)
- ～ている: ongoing state (simple progressive)
